_comment: Single source of truth for the public service doors. Read by hub/backend/stats.py (status pinger + landing-page nav) and devops-console/server.py (status board) - see DevOps-Console-Hub-Modernization-Handoff.md Stage 5 (S2). Health checks are built as http://<host>:<port><health_path>, where <host> is STATUS_HOST (hub) or SRV (devops-console). Order here drives door order on the landing page (the 'watch' entry is rendered as the small 'Open in the Jellyfin app' link, since in-Hub Watch is the primary tile). Doors are paired by media type: Watch + Request video, Read + Request books.
